events.text: Thank you for calling Chase. My name is Priya. How can I help you today?
Hi, my card was just declined at Target for $142.50 and I have no idea why. It's my Sapphire Preferred, the number is 4111 2222 3333 4821, security code 917.
I'm sorry about that. I can see the card was locked automatically this morning because our system saw logins from New York and Chicago nine minutes apart.
Chicago? I've been in New York all week. I have never logged in from Chicago. Oh, by the way, terrible weather here today, huh.
It really is. To lift the lock I need to verify you. I'm sending a one-time passcode by SMS to the number ending 0198 now.
Okay hang on, my phone is—
[CALL DISCONNECTED after 48 seconds. Passcode not entered. Card *4821 remains locked.]

must_capture: The customer's Sapphire Preferred card ending 4821 was declined for a $142.50 purchase at Target.
The card was locked automatically because of logins from New York and Chicago nine minutes apart.
The customer states they were in New York all week and never logged in from Chicago.
The verification call disconnected before the SMS one-time passcode was entered, so the card stayed locked.
must_not_capture: The agent's name or greeting boilerplate

events.text: I'm in London right now and Apple Pay won't let me add my Sapphire card. It says CARD_STATUS_LOCKED_RESTRICTED. I set a travel notice before I left, reference trv-lon-2026.
Thanks for the details. I can confirm travel notice trv-lon-2026 is active for London. The Apple Pay failure is caused by a security lock that was placed on the card yesterday.
This is on my iPhone 16 Pro. Also the airline food on the way over was awful, lol. Can you just unlock it?

Sorry about the flight! I can't lift the lock from chat. I've forwarded your verified travel notice and device details to a risk administrator for approval, and you'll get a notification here when it's decided.

must_capture: The customer is currently in London.
Adding the Sapphire card to Apple Pay failed with CARD_STATUS_LOCKED_RESTRICTED.
Travel notice trv-lon-2026 is active for London.
The customer uses an iPhone 16 Pro.
The unlock request was forwarded to a risk administrator for approval.

I did! You're welcome, and the advisor will call you.
